context.task: Find late orders and act on them
context.fixture: Five visible shipments and three totals

scope: 390 by 844 CSS pixel resting screenshot; visible first viewport only
label: Modern SaaS minimalism preference fit
weightProvenance: User-requested preference; weights and anchors authored for this skill, not empirically validated.

task.reason: Delay status is not in the visible columns, but hidden columns, filtering and task completion were not tested. This is a specific priority concern, not proof that the whole task is impossible.
evidence: assets/examples/dashboard-phone.png — Order, Destination and Carrier are the visible columns

legibility.reason: The still supports visual inspection, but actual text/state contrast and applicable accessibility checks were not measured.
evidence: assets/examples/dashboard-phone.png — screenshot only; no computed styles

interaction.reason: Keyboard, focus, horizontal scrolling, filtering and assignment were not exercised.
evidence: No behavioral evidence in this scoped review

adaptation.reason: Only one viewport and resting fixture were inspected; text growth and other widths are untested.

breakdown.label: Quiet hierarchy
breakdown.anchor: Main task is visible, but headings, navigation or actions still compete.
breakdown.reason: The content is orderly, but the large filled Export report control and heading lead the initial view while shipment delay status is absent from the visible table.
evidence: assets/examples/dashboard-phone.png — header, export control and table columns
breakdown.tradeoff: Export may be frequent; its actual frequency is unknown.
breakdown.nextChange: Prioritize a visible late-status field or filter beside order identity; consider quieter export treatment only after confirming task priority.
breakdown.preserve: Visible totals and clear shipment identity

breakdown.label: Restrained surfaces
breakdown.anchor: Flat content planes and purposeful boundaries; elevation identifies overlays.
breakdown.reason: One bounded table and restrained row dividers express grouping without a separate floating card around every shipment.
evidence: assets/examples/dashboard-phone.png — table shell and row dividers
breakdown.tradeoff: Removing more dividers could weaken exact row comparison.
breakdown.nextChange: No containment change is justified by this still; retain the table boundary.

breakdown.label: Typography-led composition
breakdown.anchor: Compact readable sans-led UI, distinct roles, intentional weight and number alignment.
breakdown.reason: Clearly distinct heading, section label, column labels and data roles create readable hierarchy at the displayed size; heading wraps coherently.
evidence: assets/examples/dashboard-phone.png — heading, table header and body
breakdown.tradeoff: Actual font size and contrast were not measured, and text growth was not exercised.
breakdown.nextChange: Verify the same hierarchy with enlarged text before changing type scale.
breakdown.preserve: Readable destination labels and strong section label

breakdown.label: Useful density and rhythm
breakdown.anchor: Efficient rows/groups, clear internal versus external spacing, breathing room at transitions.
breakdown.reason: Five aligned rows and closely grouped metrics give useful scanning density; spacing separates summary from detail.
evidence: assets/examples/dashboard-phone.png — summary metrics and five shipment rows
breakdown.tradeoff: The blank lower viewport alone does not prove wasted space; adding decorative panels would not help.
breakdown.nextChange: Recheck grouping with a longer queue and long destination names; do not fill empty space merely for appearance.
breakdown.preserve: Compact row comparison and breathing room around major groups

breakdown.label: Precise component language
breakdown.anchor: Related control geometry, restrained radii and crisp icons; explicit labels where needed.
breakdown.reason: The table, metric rules and restrained corner treatment appear related and aligned in the visible state.
evidence: assets/examples/dashboard-phone.png — metric rules, table frame and export control
breakdown.tradeoff: One still cannot establish focus, selected and error-state coherence.
breakdown.nextChange: Inspect focus and selected-row states in the browser before assigning a refined-state rating.
breakdown.preserve: Consistent dividers and aligned column headings

breakdown.label: Purposeful color
breakdown.anchor: Neutral or low-chroma working surfaces; accents identify action, selection, data or status.
breakdown.reason: A quiet pale base and dark green accent provide a restrained working palette; no competing decorative gradients appear.
evidence: assets/examples/dashboard-phone.png — background, metric rules and export button
breakdown.tradeoff: Shipment state colors are not visible, so the state palette remains unreviewed outside this scope.
breakdown.nextChange: When exposing delay state, retain a textual status label and use color semantically.
breakdown.preserve: Restrained warm palette and readable-looking data

breakdown.label: Product-specific restraint
breakdown.anchor: Restrained brand details, deliberate neutrality or domain-specific content ground the design in its product.
breakdown.reason: Dispatch vocabulary, carrier names, East Coast scope and update timing ground the neutral interface in operational work.
evidence: assets/examples/dashboard-phone.png — eyebrow, table contents and footer
breakdown.tradeoff: Brand ownership cannot be established from this fixture.
breakdown.nextChange: No added illustration or logo novelty is justified; retain concrete domain language.
